official: 青梅市一般職の職員の給与に関する条例の一部を改正する 条例
session: 令和7年市議会定例会令和8年2月定例議会

sources.label: 議案審議結果一覧（令和7年市議会定例会令和8年2月定例議会）

name: 市職員の住居・通勤手当を改定
summary: 市の一般職職員の住居手当と通勤手当は、条例で定められています。この議案では、住居手当を年齢や家賃額などに応じて整理し、通勤手当に駐車場料金に応じた額を設けるほか、距離別の支給額表を改めます。原則として2026年4月1日から施行し、一部の改正は公布日から施行します。
changes: 住居手当を年齢・家賃額などに応じて月7,500円、15,000円または30,000円とし、該当区分が重なる場合は合算する
要件を満たす駐車場を利用し料金を負担する職員に、月5,000円を上限とする通勤手当を設ける
自転車等の通勤手当を、片道距離と職員区分に応じた額に改める
一部の規定で、市長が定める内容を市規則で定める形に改める
why: 東京都人事委員会勧告を踏まえ、住居手当および通勤手当を改めるためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Revises housing and commuting allowances for Ome City general-service employees
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Salaries of General-Service Employees of Ome City
en.summary: Housing and commuting allowances for the city's general-service employees are set by ordinance. This bill reorganizes housing allowance categories according to age, rent amount and other factors, establishes commuting allowance amounts based on parking fees, and revises the payment table by commuting distance. It will generally take effect on April 1, 2026, with some amendments taking effect on the date of promulgation.
changes: Sets the housing allowance at ¥7,500, ¥15,000 or ¥30,000 per month according to age, rent amount and other factors, and combines amounts when categories overlap
Establishes a commuting allowance of up to ¥5,000 per month for employees who use qualifying parking and pay the fee
Revises commuting allowances for bicycles and similar means of transport to amounts based on one-way distance and employee category
Changes some provisions so that matters determined by the mayor are instead determined by city rules
who: Ome City general-service employees affected by the housing allowance changes
Ome City general-service employees who use qualifying parking and pay the fee
Ome City general-service employees who commute by bicycle or similar means
Ome City general-service employees covered by the provisions being revised
en.why: The city says this is to revise housing and commuting allowances in light of the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Personnel Commission recommendation.
